about: Thesis claims labelled with the typed test the claim compiler (app.core.claimtest) should produce, or "none" when the claim is not a numeric claim this version can compute. Written by hand on 18 November 2026 by a Claude Opus session, before the grammar existed, and not changed after it was scored. `make claim-labels` scores the compiler: a claim scores when its printed canonical test equals `expected` exactly ("none" included). The `development` set may be read while writing the grammar; the `held_out` set is scored only twice, at the first working grammar and at the final one, and never tuned on. On 18 November 2026 ten labels (d104, d105, d121, d122, d124, d130, d140, d142, h049, h050) were changed from none to a test, because the tool's measure set grew to include the measure each names; no other label was touched (docs/claim-tests.md, 'Labels changed when the measure set grew').

canonical_form.metric: a key of app.core.metrics.SPECS without its _yoy/_qoq variants (revenue, gross_margin, operating_margin, net_margin, eps_diluted, rnd_ratio, operating_cash_flow, capex, free_cash_flow, fcf_margin, cash, inventory, receivables), plus gross_profit, operating_income, net_income, rnd and operating_expenses; since 18 November 2026 also any measure of the claim-test catalogue (app.core.measures: share_repurchases, dividends_paid, shareholder_returns, total_debt, net_cash, income_tax, deferred_revenue, total_assets and the others it lists)
canonical_form.period: Q = the latest quarter; Q-1 = the quarter before it; Q-4 = the same quarter a year earlier; FY = the latest fiscal year; FY-N = N fiscal years before it; FY2026 = fiscal 2026; Q2 FY2027 = the second quarter of fiscal 2027; TTM = the four quarters to the latest; TTM-4 = the four quarters to a year earlier; filing = the newest filing's tagged breakdowns. For a balance-sheet amount (cash, inventory, receivables), Q is the latest balance sheet
canonical_form.defaults: with no period words, a margin, ratio, growth or direction claim reads the latest quarter (Q against Q-4 for a direction); an amount of money or a per-share amount reads the latest fiscal year (FY); a balance-sheet amount reads the latest balance sheet (Q); 'annual' or 'last fiscal year' reads FY; 'sequentially' or 'quarter over quarter' compares Q with Q-1

forms.direction: m[P] > m[P'] (growing, expanding, rising) or m[P] < m[P'] (shrinking, declining)
forms.streak: streak(m)[P] >= N: m rose in each of the last N periods against the period before
forms.growth_threshold: yoy(m)[P] op N% or qoq(m)[P] op N%; 'doubled' is > 100%; 'declined more than 10%' is < -10%
forms.share: share(segment "Name")[filing] op N%, share(geography "Name")[filing] op N%, max(share(customer))[filing] op N%; 'no customer is over N%' is max(...) <= N%

canonical_form.none: expected "none": a valuation, a cause, a forecast, a judgement, a measure not in the set, a segment's or geography's growth (breakdowns have no history in the facts), a top-N share (not tagged), a margin or measure not named, or no threshold. `why` says which
